issues.description: The POST handler for creating persons in the solution is declared with protected visibility (createPerson), while other REST handler methods (e.g. NoteResource.createNote in the template/solution) are public. The problem statement lists the endpoints as public REST endpoints. The inconsistent visibility of createPerson (protected) compared to the public handlers can confuse students about the expected method visibility for controller endpoints and is unexpected compared to the NoteResource example.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the createPerson handler public to match the visibility used by other controller methods (and the NoteResource example). Change the method signature to public ResponseEntity<Person> createPerson(...) so visibility is consistent across REST handlers.
